title: 美股休市：热PCE与新关税压制AI，纳指深跌后收窄至0.62%；周五提前收盘
title_en: U.S. Markets Closed: Hot PCE and New Tariffs Pressure AI; Nasdaq Trims a Deep Slide to 0.62%, Friday Has an Early Close
summary: 美股11月26日因感恩节休市，无官方盘前或现货成交。周三道指涨0.33%，标普500和纳指分别跌0.25%和0.62%，纳指盘中一度跌逾4%；NVDA收跌3.91%，10年期美债收益率降至4.84%，Brent涨3.5%至94.61美元。核心PCE同比升至3.3%、三季度GDP上修至4.3%，加息与关税风险仍压制AI估值；周五13:00 ET提前收盘。
summary_en: U.S. markets are closed on November 26 for Thanksgiving, with no official premarket or cash trading. On Wednesday, the Dow rose 0.33%, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq fell 0.25% and 0.62%; the Nasdaq had been down more than 4% intraday. NVDA closed down 3.91%, the 10-year Treasury yield fell to 4.84%, and Brent rose 3.5% to $94.61. Core PCE inflation accelerated to 3.3% year over year and third-quarter GDP was revised up to 4.3%, leaving rate-hike and tariff risks as valuation headwinds for AI. Friday's session closes early at 1:00 p.m. ET.

增量复核结论

事实：港股反弹但A股大盘近乎持平，前一交易日弱宽度尚未被全面修复。

判断：通信网实施方案与卫星互联网个股反馈构成结构性确认，不等于科技全面反转。

不确定性：主题内部分化明显，候选股多数仅小幅上涨，仍须观察持续性与相对强弱。

板块轮动看板

结构线索

通信网实施方案、6G试点、数字经济行动与公司事件提供定向催化；卫星互联网盘中强于大盘但内部已分化。

美股领先

抵押贷款金融、白银与博彩领涨；行业Bottom5不可得，不作推断。

压力方向

A/H宽度弱、纳指期货偏低，关税、油价与通胀抬高多头门槛。

验证信号

观察中国能建、万国数据与波司登能否相对同业走强；南大光电无反转确认前维持回避。

逻辑链

关税与通胀风险 + 布伦特上涨3.5% → 折现率与成本压力抬升 → 广谱风险偏好仍受限。
A股4379家下跌、561家上涨 + 恒生科技跌2.56% → 本地宽度弱 → 必须等待同业相对强势确认。
6G试点 + 数字经济基础设施 → 通信、芯片与数据中心需求线索 → 政策意图不等于当期收入。
公司催化分化 → EPC订单与业绩只支持条件关注；小规模回购叠加10.45%下跌支持回避。

风险雷达

11月25日科技抛售与仍偏弱的纳指期货可能继续映射至A/H芯片、服务器与互联网平台。
A股宽度极弱；指数止跌本身不能确认普涨修复。
布伦特94.61美元及中东供应风险可能强化通胀与偏鹰派利率预期。
中国能建EPC尚未正式签约；万国数据利润率与债务仍是实质反证。
行业Bottom5及多数代表股夜盘报价不可得；不对缺失数据作推断。

Keyword Map

w1-w5 indicates importance, not return magnitude.
Major News
Global
U.S. stocks recovered from intraday lows, but tech stayed weaker
On Nov. 25, the Dow rose 0.33%, the S&P 500 fell 0.25%, and the Nasdaq lost 0.62%; Nvidia fell 3.9% as markets absorbed tariff, inflation and hawkish-rate risks. Source
Geopolitics
Middle East supply risk lifted Brent by 3.5%
Brent settled at $94.61 a barrel after Yemen's Houthis said they attacked Saudi Arabia's largest refinery, raising energy-cost and inflation risks. Source
Ranking
Mortgage finance, silver and gambling led; the industry last page timed out
Industry leaders were Mortgage Finance +6.86%, Silver +4.96%, Gambling +4.82%, Pharmaceutical Retailers +4.79%, and Other Precious Metals +4.04%; Bottom 5 was unavailable. Silver, sports betting, social media, SOL reserve and food delivery led concepts. Source
Increment
The network plan received selective satellite-internet confirmation
MIIT, the Cyberspace Administration and NDRC published the New-Generation Communications Network Plan at 08:36 CST, covering satellite internet, industrial internet, connected vehicles and low-altitude communications. At 10:08 CST, Sunway Communication gained 3.40% and Shanghai Hugong 9.20%, while the Shanghai Composite slipped 0.05% and ChiNext rose only 0.09%—theme strength, not a broad risk-on recovery. Source
Policy
Eight regions launched coordinated 6G trials
MIIT approved trials in eight regions covering terminals, key chips, instruments and satellite internet; commercial applications still require licenses. Source
Policy
The 15th Five-Year digital-economy plan set a 2030 target
The National Data Administration targets core digital industries at 12.5% of GDP by 2030 and calls for an integrated computing network, national data infrastructure and smart manufacturing. Source
Technology
A generative-AI risk-governance standard proposal advanced
SAMR said China and international partners are advancing ISO/IEC TS 25568 on deepfakes, model poisoning and inference-service safety; it remains a standards proposal. Source
Infrastructure
Three Gorges new shipping corridor investment exceeded RMB11bn
NDRC said the project is progressing on schedule and coordination will intensify; it is an infrastructure signal, not a confirmed new order for a single listed company. Source
Company
A China Energy Engineering unit won a RMB5.582bn coal-power EPC project
The project includes two 1GW ultra-supercritical units with an approximately 29-month schedule; the contract has not yet been formally signed, so execution and revenue timing remain uncertain. Source
Company
GDS Q3 revenue grew while margins narrowed
Revenue rose 10.1% to RMB3.18bn and adjusted EBITDA 2.8%; utilization reached 81.2%, but gross margin fell to 19.7% and adjusted EBITDA margin to 43.4%, leaving cost and debt as counter-evidence. Source
Company
Bosideng posted modest interim revenue and profit growth
Six-month revenue was about RMB9.103bn and attributable profit RMB1.242bn, up 1.97% and 4.46%, with a proposed HK6.6-cent interim dividend; post-announcement price confirmation is unavailable. Source
Risk
Nata Opto's small buyback plan does not erase prior price pressure
The company plans a RMB20m–35m cancellation buyback, about 0.05%–0.08% of shares; it fell 10.45% on Nov. 25 and has no valid post-announcement session, so no bullish confirmation is claimed. Source

U.S. Overnight / Extended-Hours Summary

Index futures
Index futures
As of 19:47 UTC Nov. 25 (delayed): S&P 500 futures -0.48%, Nasdaq-100 futures -1.06%, and Dow futures +0.38%. U.S. cash markets are closed Nov. 26 for Thanksgiving.
Sector comparison
Sector comparison
The mixed futures tape confirms defensive/value resilience but diverges from the cash-session silver and gambling strength. EXK -5.42% and DKNG -0.54% after hours were potential reversals; other representative tickers had no reliable new extended-hours quote.
A/H mapping
A/H mapping
At 10:08 CST, the Hang Seng Index rose 1.42%, the Shanghai Composite slipped 0.05%, and ChiNext gained 0.09%. The network plan lifted satellite-internet names selectively, while candidate follow-through stayed modest, preserving conditional watch and risk-control states.

Incremental Review Conclusion

Fact: Hong Kong rebounded, but mainland indices were nearly flat and the prior weak breadth has not been broadly repaired.

Judgment: the network plan and satellite-internet price action are selective confirmation, not a wholesale technology reversal.

Uncertainty: dispersion is high and most watch-list names are only modestly positive, so persistence and peer-relative strength still matter.

Key Stock Watch

China Energy Engineering
601868.SH / 03996.HK
Conditional watch
Facts and status：A subsidiary won a RMB5.582bn coal-power EPC project, but the contract is not formally signed. At 10:05-10:07 CST, A shares were flat at RMB2.24 and H shares up 0.59% at HK$0.855—modest, not peer-relative confirmation. Source
Confirmation：Require at least one listing to outperform infrastructure SOE peers after the open, plus disclosure of contract signing, payments and revenue-recognition timing.
Risks and invalidation：Unsigned contract, 29-month execution, collection and coal-capex risks; cancel the watch if both listings remain weaker than peers.
GDS Holdings-SW
09698.HK / GDS.US
Conditional watch
Facts and status：Q3 revenue rose 10.1% and utilization reached 81.2%, but gross margin fell to 19.7% and adjusted EBITDA margin to 43.4%. Hong Kong shares reached HK$13.53 early, then faded to HK$12.81, +1.34%, at 10:07 CST—limited confirmation. Source
Confirmation：Require Hong Kong shares to outperform Hang Seng Tech and data-center peers, with utilization gains, margin stabilization and capex discipline.
Risks and invalidation：Power costs, debt and expansion needs remain material; cancel the watch if Hong Kong weakness or margin compression persists.
Bosideng
03998.HK
Conditional watch
Facts and status：Interim revenue rose 1.97%, attributable profit 4.46%, and a HK6.6-cent dividend was proposed. At 10:07 CST, shares were HK$4.495, +0.90%, after reaching HK$4.565—modest positive feedback. Source
Confirmation：Require post-open outperformance versus consumer-discretionary peers, with healthy core down-apparel revenue and inventory turns.
Risks and invalidation：Growth is modest and womenswear revenue declined; cancel the watch on a failed gap-up or worsening inventory and discounting.
Nata Opto-electronic
300346.SZ
Avoid
Facts and status：The proposed RMB20m–35m cancellation buyback equals only about 0.05%–0.08% of shares. At 10:07 CST, the stock was RMB37.75, +0.61%, after a 10.45% prior-day drop; the small rebound is not reversal confirmation. Source
Confirmation：Reassess only if execution approaches the upper limit and the stock stabilizes and outperforms semiconductor-material peers in a valid session.
Risks and invalidation：The buyback is small, requires shareholder approval and follows severe price pressure; remain avoid until a verified reversal.

Sector Rotation Board

Selective positives

The network plan, 6G trials, digital policy and company events offer targeted catalysts; satellite-internet names outperformed the market but were already dispersed.

U.S. leadership

Mortgage finance, silver and gambling led; the industry Bottom 5 was unavailable and is not inferred.

Pressure points

A/H breadth was weak, Nasdaq futures remained lower, and tariffs, oil and inflation raised the hurdle for long exposure.

Validation

Watch China Energy Engineering, GDS and Bosideng for peer-relative strength; keep Nata Opto avoided without a verified reversal.

Logic Chain

Tariff and inflation risk + Brent +3.5% → higher discount rates and input costs → broad risk appetite remains constrained.
A-share decliners 4,379 vs advancers 561 + Hang Seng Tech -2.56% → weak local breadth → require peer-relative confirmation.
6G trials + digital-economy infrastructure → communications, chips and data-center demand themes → policy intent is not immediate revenue.
Company catalysts split → EPC order and earnings support conditional watches; a small buyback plus a 10.45% drop supports an avoid state.

Risk Radar

The Nov. 25 technology selloff and still-negative Nasdaq futures can spill into A/H chips, servers and internet platforms.
A-share breadth was extremely weak; index stabilization would not by itself confirm a broad recovery.
Oil at $94.61 and Middle East supply risk can reinforce inflation and hawkish-rate expectations.
China Energy Engineering's EPC project is not formally signed; GDS margins and debt remain material counter-evidence.
The industry Bottom 5 and most representative-ticker extended-hours quotes were unavailable; no missing data is inferred.
